name: bitcrusher
author: coldsoldr
description: Sample-rate and bit-depth reduction in stereo: te-op1-cfw's kennel bitcrusher (coldsoldr, ports/knl/bitcrusher at 5aa314b; its DSP ports/fx/src/crush), GPL-3.0-or-later. Blue rate (44.1 kHz down to 500 Hz), green bits (16 down to 2), white jitter, orange mix; fn + blue the input gain into the crusher (-6..+6 dB, shift + fn + blue fine).
